name: audiobook-codex
description: Native-only Codex workflow for mapping books, preserving source text, translating whole foreign-language books, creating faithful fluid PT-BR reading editions, reviewing narrator text, exporting EPUB/PDF editions, and rendering local Chatterbox PT-BR audiobooks.

interface.shortDescription: Map, translate or fluid-edit books, export EPUB/PDF, and render audio.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-only audiobook workflow for PDF and EPUB sources. It uses native PDF and Computer Use capabilities when available, dedicated Codex agents for visual transcription, contextual PT-BR translation, faithful fluid PT-BR editing, ambiguity research, and verification, native image editing for opt-in reviewed derivatives, semantic EPUB/PDF packaging, and local Chatterbox PT-BR audio.
